title: Whole-body CT in multiple injured patients - Influence of a novel arm positioning pillow on image quality, examination time and radiation exposure
summary: There are various examination protocols for the wholebody-CT of severely injured patients using different positioning of the arms. The intended trial will examine the influence of a novel arm positioning pillow in terms of image quality, examination time and radiation exposure for wholebody-CT scans with arms alongside the body.
conditions: Patients after severe accident with suspicion of severe injuries

interventions.name: Whole-body CT with arms alongside the trunk
Whole-body CT with arms ventral to the trunk, using the novel arm positioning pillow
Whole-body CT using "Swimmers-Position" (1 arm elevated over the head, 1 arm alongside the body)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Admission of the trauma patient to the emergency department of the HBK Zwickau.

2 . A wholebody-CT was performed in the context of routine care after severe accident in the scanner located in the emergency department.

3. The wholebody-ct was performed in the study period between 01.01.2019 and 31.12.2020.

4. Patient’s age ≥ 16 years.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Incomplete bodyscan (less than standard scan range from shoulder girdle to the seat bone was scanned).

2. Other deviations from the standard protocol or technical difficulties while the examination.

3. Missing radiation dose reportin PACS.
